info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Utbms Codes API
Return the data for all UtbmsCodes

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter UtbmsCode records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter UtbmsCode records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of UtbmsCode records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the UtbmsCode records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter UtbmsCode records to those of a given type.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter UtbmsCode records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: utbms_set_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single UtbmsSet. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a UtbmsCode. The list will be filtered to include only the UtbmsCode records with the matching property.
